# Highlight Creations

> Highlight Creations is a full-service destination wedding planning company
> operating across Agra, Bharatpur, Jaipur, and Udaipur, India. We plan
> palace, fort, and heritage-venue weddings end to end — venue sourcing,
> décor, logistics, vendor management, guest hospitality, and permits.

We are best suited for: couples and families planning a multi-day
destination wedding at a palace, fort, haveli, or luxury resort in
Rajasthan or Agra, typically for 100–1000+ guests, who want a single
planner to manage the entire event rather than a single vendor.
